content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, trying to sell ebooks or courses online, but [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-step-step|COREMERCH guide to creators]]-which-architecture-actually-works-5|Stripe Alternatives]], PayPal, and Gumroad won't let you because of platform restrictions. You're not alone. Many creators in 20+ countries face the same problem. They can't collect payments, deliver products, or store customer data on conventional platforms. This is due to limitations, fees, or outright bans on cryptocurrency transactions. The question is: how can you sell digital products without relying on these platforms? The answer lies in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-until-you|build]]ing a sovereign digital commerce stack, one that gives you full control over payment processing, product delivery, and data ownership.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a combination of free and paid tools that allow you to host, sell, and deliver digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. It's not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that gives you full control over your business. With a sovereign stack, you can process payments, store customer data, and deliver products without depending on third-party platforms. This means you can sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and other digital products without giving up control or paying high fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack consists of several components, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee and support for 300+ cryptocurrencies. The stack is designed to be highly scalable, secure, and customizable, allowing you to deploy it in just 48 hours.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in countries where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unavailable. It's perfect for ebook authors, course creators, template designers, font makers, and other sellers of digital products who want to maintain full control over their business. By building a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can break free from platform fees, limitations, and censorship, and focus on creating and selling your products without interference.
A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you full control over payment processing, product delivery, and data ownership.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work together seamlessly to provide a seamless buying and selling experience. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your digital products, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic and payment processing. Supabase or Google Sheets store customer data and orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files to customers. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain and provides support for multiple cryptocurrencies.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question you're likely asking is: how do I sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad? The answer is to build a sovereign digital commerce stack using a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Google Apps Script, Supabase, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Cloudflare R2, and NOWPayments. This stack gives you full control over payment processing, product delivery, and data ownership, and can be deployed in just 48 hours.
Conventional payment platforms charge high fees and impose limitations on digital creators.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a solution to sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, you're not alone. Many creators in 20+ countries face the same problem. To learn more about building a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. You can shop for the Complete Builder Kit at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and download the templates and blueprints. Choose a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up your digital product store. Configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic and payment processing. Set up Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Configure NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and start selling your digital products.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I process payments on a sovereign digital commerce stack?
Payments are processed using NOWPayments, which provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee and support for 300+ cryptocurrencies.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack with any hosting platform?
Yes, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack with any hosting platform, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Cloud Storage.
How do I store customer data on a sovereign digital commerce stack?
Customer data is stored using Supabase or Google Sheets, which provide secure and scalable storage solutions for your orders and customer information.
Can I deliver files to customers using a sovereign digital commerce stack?
Yes, files can be delivered to customers using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, which provide secure and scalable file delivery solutions.
How do I configure NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification?
NOWPayments can be configured for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification by following the instructions provided in the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack with multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack with multiple cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and many others.
